figures.name: project_overview
figures.title: Research overview
figures.caption: Paired observations feed segmentation; CyAN is a separate reference source, not a laboratory target. The matched pilot and v2 are distinct experiments, not comparable Test pools.

figures.name: final_geographic_split
figures.title: Geographic split
figures.caption: Native CyAN author-grid positions. Gray parents are not selected into v2. Exact lake boundaries and cross-tile nonoverlap remain unverified.

figures.name: final_class_distribution
figures.title: Class distribution
figures.caption: All valid pixels, not independent observations. Deliberate Test enrichment prevents natural-population precision or calibration claims.

figures.name: final_model_comparison
figures.title: Central model comparison
figures.caption: Fixed model order, not ranked by Test. NDCI is selected despite zero validation High F1; the weighted CNN fails the class guard.

figures.name: final_regional_high_f1
figures.title: Per-region High F1
figures.caption: Three observed component scores; no pixel bootstrap and no population confidence intervals.

figures.name: final_segmentation_attribution
figures.title: Segmentation and attribution
figures.caption: Phase4 maximum-High-support attribution case in the LR/CNN worst-High-F1 region: 6_2_X0650_Y0950_S050_2020_07_17_x320_y384_64x64_58. It was not selected for visual success. Target is fixed true-High-region mean High logit.

figures.name: final_calibration
figures.title: High-class calibration
figures.caption: Fifteen equal-width bins; bottom panels show uncalibrated bin populations. Temperature uses Validation only and does not alter argmax. Pixel counts are correlated.

figures.name: final_robustness
figures.title: Robustness
figures.caption: Twelve registered perturbations. Partial masking is artifact stress, not a cloud-physics model. Small deltas do not repair weak baseline performance.

figures.name: final_band_ablation
figures.title: Band ablation
figures.caption: All12 exceeds RGB in this run, but the 8-band variant has higher Macro F1. Single-seed two-epoch results do not establish a stable spectral advantage.

figures.name: final_failure_examples
figures.title: Failure examples
figures.caption: Three existing Phase4 extreme diagnostic cases in the worst High-F1 region. The whole patch need not belong to the named category.
